name: ai-upscaling-models
description: My self-trained AI models for photorealistic image upscaling and restoration. Built on ESRGAN, SAFMN, RealPLKSR and other architectures and trained on a manually curated high-end dataset (11,750+ real-world HD images). Models excel at restoring authentic textures and objects (skin, fabric, grit) and handle various types of degradation.
